item.description:

Tuesday: SSW wind 10 to 15 kt. Sunny. Seas around 3 ft.

Tuesday Night: SW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming W after midnight. Mostly clear. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Wednesday: W wind 5 to 10 kt becoming SSW in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas around 2 ft.

Wednesday Night: SSW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming WNW after midnight. Partly cloudy. Seas 2 to 3 ft.
